name: CTA tile shape for SM90 TMA-WGMMA mainloops
summary: Choose an M-by-N-by-K CTA tile that is statically known and divisible by the selected tiled MMA and TMA copy partitions.

strategy.intent: Expose sufficient reuse and parallel Tensor Core work within each Hopper thread block.
strategy.mechanism: Partition a CTA tile into WGMMA atoms and TMA copy tiles while enforcing compile-time shape compatibility.
strategy.expected_benefit: Balances data reuse, Tensor Core utilization, shared-memory use, and grid parallelism.
tradeoffs: Larger tiles consume more shared memory and registers.
A shape that is good for large GEMMs may reduce parallelism on small problems.

constraints.rationale: The collective is specialized for Hopper mainloops.
The implementation applies compile-time rank and divisibility checks.

constraints.expression: tile_m % mma_m == 0 && tile_n % mma_n == 0 && tile_k % mma_k == 0
constraints.rationale: The tiled MMA must exactly partition the CTA tile.
Tile size and pipeline depth jointly determine shared-memory use.

references.evidence: The specialization binds TileShape, TiledMma, and TMA copies and checks their ranks and compatible partitions.
